mini0111(postgresql.conf.sample) is omitted from the adapted aggregate.

The original patch changes only the commented autovacuum_freeze_max_age
default from 200000000 to 10000000000. Its own GUC registration (in v67-0004)
and our mini0109(guc_parameters.dat) both retain boot_val = 200000000.
Keep the sample consistent with that actual default. No runtime setting or
default is changed; wider configurable limits come from mini0109.
